sources.title: Llava_v1.5_13b-Model-Colab - GitHub
sources.snippet: LLaVA-1.5-13B is a state-of-the-art multimodal model achieving remarkable performance across 11 benchmarks. It builds upon the original LLaVA framework, utilizing publicly available data to train on a single 8-A100 node in approximately one day. This version surpasses previous methods by leveraging billion-scale data and demonstrating exceptional capabilities in visual and language understanding.
